name: univer
description: The Office Harness for AI Agents — Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides, Canvas, Relational Tables, and PDF in one runtime.
one_liner: An embeddable office suite (spreadsheets, docs, slides) that developers can drop into their own app, so AI agents and users can edit real documents inside a product instead of exporting to Excel.
buyer: A product manager at a vertical SaaS company (e.g. a CRM or ops tool) who keeps losing deals because customers want native spreadsheet/document editing inside the product.
business_use_cases: A vertical SaaS (e.g. construction or logistics software) embeds it to offer 'built-in spreadsheets' instead of telling customers to use Excel on the side.
An AI agent startup uses it as the canvas where its agents actually edit a real spreadsheet or doc live in front of the user.
An internal-tools team builds a lightweight Notion/Airtable-style app for a client using it as the document engine.

money_ideas.idea: Paid integration/customization service embedding it into a client's existing SaaS product.
Template/plugin marketplace for pre-built spreadsheet and document components.

steal_this: Embed it in a demo app this weekend showing an AI agent editing a live spreadsheet, and pitch it to a SaaS product missing document features.
